730350102.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you seem fresh, like fresh Zaytun Peaches. But Paimon looks unhappy. Did you have a nightmare?

730350103.text: Paimon was afraid you'd abandoned us!

730350104.text: Why would you think that? I've been here the whole time.

730350106.text: B—Because Vanarana is in a dream, and the fun we had at Festival Utsava was like a dream... Paimon was afraid that everything would all go away once we woke up...

730350107.text: We'd be all that's left, just like when we first started the journey...

730350108.text: But the things that happen in dreams are real. I have observed Nara before and found that nightmares would make them timid, and that nice dreams would make them happy, just like things that happen outside their dreams.

730350109.text: So when Paimon dreamed of meeting us and also dreamed of meeting Vanarana, Paimon, it was as real as doing both in reality.

730350115.text: That's right. We've got to go to the Fane of Ashvattha to get the Bija so Narana can get better!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Fane of Ashvattha
Go to the Fane of Ashvattha

730350201.text: #Wonderful, this place isn't corroded by Marana like Arayama and the others were! Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, this is the Ashvattha Tree.

730350203.text: That's rude, Paimon! You'll make the Ashvattha Tree mad! This is a very, very mighty tree — the oldest Vasara Tree there is. Even older than any Aranara and their stories...

730350204.text: Queen Aranyani sang here — thousands of moons ago, or perhaps even more. She had just left Valuka at the time, and the woods weren't as lush as now, so there was still lots of sand on the ground.

730350205.text: Her Ararakalari was more powerful than any Aranara's, since her song was the closest to the Sourcesong. So Ashvattha responded to her call and sprouted from Sarva.

730350206.text: Queen Aranyani told Ashvattha that there were many smart, beautiful, yet lonely Nara in the woods and that the children of the forest must increase so that they might become friends with the Nara.

730350207.text: Therefore, Ashvattha produced a beautiful and full pomegranate with many seeds inside, the first of which to sprout was Aramuhukunda.

730350208.text: That made Aramuhukunda the very first Aranara. Later, all the seeds grew and Aranara spread like leaves on a tree. We and Nara were both people of the forest.

730350209.text: That's why the Ashvattha Tree is very powerful and very important! Just like Nara bear Nara children, all Aranara are progeny of Ashvattha and Queen Aranyani.

730350210.text: So that's how it is... Sorry, Arama. The Ashvattha Tree is super impressive!

730350212.text: Paimon didn't mean to! Anyway, what do we need to do now to get the Bija?

730350214.text: Right. Just like trees need earth and rain to flourish, dreams and memories are what a Vasara Tree needs. As I mentioned a moment ago, the Ashvattha Tree is the oldest of the Vasara Trees.

730350215.text: That's why we've brought three Vasoma Fruits from Araji, Arayama, and Aramaha as offerings for the Ashvattha Tree to bear great fruit.

730350216.text: Araji, Arayama, and Aramaha's Vasoma Fruits? Don't you mean the fruits of the Vasara Trees?

730350218.text: #Stand closer to the Ashvattha Tree, Nara {NICKNAME}.

730350901.text: Finally we are here. Huh... Paimon remembers that we could see this mysterious tree in other Vasara Trees' dreams as well!

730350902.text: #I'm sorry, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. It escaped me that Marana has also corroded the Ashvattha Tree's dream...

730350903.text: Countless black pests are corroding the roots of the Tree of Dreams in Sarva. I can feel Marana's hands, shaking the dream to its core.

730350904.text: Sorry... I should have known this would've been the case when we saw Marana in Ashvattha's Concourses before.

730350905.text: #It's okay! We fixed this easily with {NICKNAME} around, didn't we?

730350912.text: #The Vasoma Fruits should at least restore some of his power. I'm counting on you, Nara {NICKNAME}.

730350914.text: Yes, I understand. I didn't think it would be so soon, but I'm aware that I'll know what to do when the time comes.

730350915.text: Just like the clouds know that they must release rain, and the rain knows that it must fall to the ground, seeds know that they must grow into big trees and bear lots of plump fruits.

730350917.text: Oh, I was just speaking to the Tree of Dreams. Huh, so you couldn't hear it.

730350918.text: Paimon's seen Aranakin talking to mushrooms before... But people can't normally communicate with plants, you know?

730350919.text: I see! I just learned something new. Thank you, Paimon.

730350920.text: #Don't worry about the Bija, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Let's just leave the dream for now.

730350908.text: But... Will what happened here affect the Bija in any way?

730350910.text: Well, you did it regardless, right?

730350911.text: But... Will what happened here affect the Bija in any way?

730350401.text: The heart of the Ashvattha Tree is glowing... Is that the Bija?

730350402.text: It hasn't been easy, but Rana can finally be healed!

730350408.text: The Ashvattha Tree has been corroded by Marana and cannot bear any Bija. I have to plant a new Ashvattha Tree in order to help you.

730350409.text: But won't it require a long time to grow from a seed to a tree?

730350410.text: Don't worry, the speed of a Vasara Tree's growth has to do with its seed. The Ashvattha Tree has given me all its power, and with the Vasoma Fruits and our shared memory, it will be fine.

730350411.text: Thank you, the first Ashvattha Tree. Thank you, Araji, Arayama, and Aramaha. I will utilize your memories to rebuild the path between the new Ashvattha Tree and the dreams.

730350412.text: Do you get the feeling that Arama's different now...

730350413.text: Am I? I learned a lot of new things, figured out lots of new words, and obtained a lot of memories.

730350414.text: But rest assured, I'm still me, your friend. I will help you for sure.

730350302.text: Why would The Withering be in the Ashvattha Tree's dream?

730350303.text: Regardless, we've got to get rid of The Withering as soon as possible!

730350601.text: #Wonderful, this place isn't corroded by Marana like Arayama and the others were! Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, this is the Ashvattha Tree.

730350603.text: That's rude, Paimon! You'll make the Ashvattha Tree mad! This is a very, very mighty tree — the oldest Vasara Tree there is. Even older than any Aranara and their stories...

730350604.text: The Lord of Verdure sang here — thousands of moons ago, or perhaps even more. She had just left Valuka at the time, and the woods weren't as lush as now, so there was still lots of sand on the ground.

730350605.text: Her Ararakalari was more powerful than any Aranara's, since her song was the closest to the Sourcesong. So Ashvattha responded to her call and sprouted from Sarva.

730350606.text: She told Ashvattha that there were many smart, beautiful, yet lonely Nara in the woods and that the children of the forest must increase so that they might become friends with the Nara.

730350607.text: Therefore, Ashvattha produced a beautiful and full pomegranate with many seeds inside, the first of which to sprout was Aramuhukunda.

730350608.text: That made Aramuhukunda the very first Aranara. Later, all the seeds grew and Aranara spread like leaves on a tree. We and Nara were both people of the forest.

730350609.text: That's why the Ashvattha Tree is very powerful and very important! Just like Nara bear Nara children, all Aranara are progeny of Ashvattha, of the Dendro Archon.

730350610.text: So that's how it is... Sorry, Arama. The Ashvattha Tree is super impressive!

730350612.text: Paimon didn't mean to! Anyway, what do we need to do now to get the Bija?

730350614.text: Right. Just like trees need earth and rain to flourish, dreams and memories are what a Vasara Tree needs. As I mentioned a moment ago, the Ashvattha Tree is the oldest of the Vasara Trees.

730350615.text: That's why we've brought three Vasoma Fruits from Araji, Arayama, and Aramaha as offerings for the Ashvattha Tree to bear great fruit.

730350616.text: Araji, Arayama, and Aramaha's Vasoma Fruits? Don't you mean the fruits of the Vasara Trees?

730350618.text: #Stand closer to the Ashvattha Tree, Nara {NICKNAME}.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go deep into the Fane of Ashvattha

730350501.text: #Are you ready to enter the Ashvattha Tree's dream, Nara {NICKNAME}?

730350503.text: #Paimon believes it won't be a problem for {NICKNAME}!

730350508.text: Sure. Let me know when you're ready. I'll go with you!
